From: Claire Huang <claire@sapphiresolutions.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Intro — partnership commercial ask (finder fee + demo credits)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the product looked great and the integration quickstart gave our solutions team confidence. We've got a couple of mid-market prospects that would be a good fit for Redwood and we'd like to propose a simple commercial structure to move forward:

1) Finder fee for first-paid customer introduced directly by Sapphire: 6% of initial ARR (one-time payout).
2) Demo credit: Sapphire would like a pool of credits to redeem for hosted trials / pilot seats (we suggest $6k total, usable over 90 days for each introduced account).
3) Lead registration window: 180 days from mutual intro to be eligible for finder fee (with reasonable proof).

We're happy to sign an MSA addendum or a one-page reseller/referral appendix. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires an escrow for demo credits (we've seen partners ask for this)? Also curious on any exclusions (e.g., existing pipeline, co-sell carve-outs).

Attached is a short two-pager on how Sapphire runs discovery + demo handoffs.

Best,
Claire Huang
Head of Alliances | Sapphire Solutions
[Attachment: Sapphire_Partner_Brief.pdf (pdf)]

---

Note: please include legal and partner ops on any formal terms, happy to coordinate a call next week.

Hi Claire — great to hear and thanks for the clear proposal.

High level response before we loop legal:
- Finder fee: 6% initial ARR is within typical range for our referral partners. We usually pay on first invoice / first 30 days after contract execution.
- Demo credit pool: we can provision a $6k pilot credit, but we manage credits from Partnership Ops and typically require a short SOW or pilot acceptance criteria. We do not put credits into a third-party escrow, but we can hold credits on our platform and allocate by account ID so they are auditable.
- Registration window: 180 days is fine; we ask for an introduction record in HubSpot (email thread or calendar invite) to validate.

Next steps: I'm looping Marissa (Partner Ops) and will also pull Legal for the MSA redlines. Can you share the prospect list (company names only) and preferred timing? If you want, I can send a one-page referral appendix that covers the above and the payout mechanics.

Appreciate it,

Claire / Ben — quick operational notes from Partner Ops so terms are actionable: 

1) Credits mechanics: Demo credits are issued to a named HubSpot company record and expire after 90 days unless otherwise agreed. We will not release credits to an email alias; need account ID.
2) Payment: Finder fee paid within 45 days of signed invoice and subject to clawback if the customer terminates within 60 days (we use a 60-day performance window).
3) Reporting: We will provide a monthly partner statement showing credit consumption and registered leads.
4) Exceptions: If Redwood had prior active discussions (in HubSpot) with the prospect within 12 months, the finder fee is not payable.

I'll draft a short appendix and attach Demo_Credit_Tiers.xlsx with suggested denominations and tracking columns. Ben — tagging Legal for the MSA redlines.

Thanks,
